description: End-to-end encryption settings. Maps to mautrix bridgev2/bridgeconfig.EncryptionConfig.

default.description: Enable encryption in new portal rooms by default.

require.description: Require encryption — drop messages in unencrypted rooms.

plaintext_mentions.description: Include plaintext mentions alongside encrypted content.

pickle_key.description: Key for pickling Olm sessions. Set to 'generate' for auto-generation.

allow_key_sharing.description: Allow sharing Megolm keys with verified devices on request.

delete_outbound_on_ack.description: Delete outbound sessions after all devices have acknowledged.

dont_store_outbound.description: Don't store outbound sessions at all.

ratchet_on_decrypt.description: Ratchet inbound sessions forward after decrypting a message.

delete_fully_used_on_decrypt.description: Delete inbound sessions that have been fully used after decryption.

delete_prev_on_new_session.description: Delete previous inbound session when a new one is received.

delete_on_device_delete.description: Delete keys associated with a device when that device is deleted.

VerificationLevels.description: Minimum verification trust levels for various operations.

receive.description: Minimum trust level for receiving messages.

send.description: Minimum trust level for sending messages.

share.description: Minimum trust level for sharing keys.

enable_custom.description: Enable custom rotation settings (otherwise use server defaults).

milliseconds.description: Rotate sessions after this many milliseconds.

messages.description: Rotate sessions after this many messages.

disable_device_change_key_rotation.description: Don't rotate keys when a device list changes.
